raw_graphql_pull_request.body: ## Motivation `torch_npu.npu_fused_infer_attention_score` with `input_layout="TND"` requires `actual_seq_lengths` / `actual_seq_lengths_kv` to be **cumulative** sequence lengths (same semantics as FlashAttention `cu_seqlens[1:]`). The last element must equal `query.shape[0]` (packed token count `T`). [#25768](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/25768) aligned the eager Ascend path with that contract. [#31701](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/31701) fixed the ViT NPU graph runner, which still cached per-sequence lengths from the older `_npu_flash_attention_unpad` API. A third path remained broken: after [#24013](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/24013), eager ViT encoding prefers `VisionAttentionMetadata`, and `VisionAscendAttention` passed `forward_metadata.seq_lens` (per-sequence deltas) into TND. That still works for a single image (`last == T` by accident) but fails when multiple images are packed into one ViT forward — e.g. Ascend MMMU accuracy cases without `SGLANG_VIT_ENABLE_CUDA_GRAPH`, with errors such as `queryT(1000) must be equal to the last element of actualSequenceLengthQ(264)`. ## Modifications - In `VisionAscendAttention`, when `forward_metadata` is present, build TND `actual_seq_lengths` from `forward_metadata.cu_seqlens[1:]` (moved to CPU) instead of `forward_metadata.seq_lens`. - Leave `prepare_vision_attention_metadata` / `seq_lens` unchanged so other backends that still consume per-sequence lengths are unaffected. - Graph and non-metadata eager branches are unchanged (already cumulative / covered by [#31701](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/31701)). - This showed that our fix works and is in expected shape printed this: ```python print(f"++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++") print(f"cu: {cu}") print(f"seq_len = {forward_metadata.seq_lens.to('cpu')} ") seq_len_arg = cu[1:].to(torch.int32) ``` and got ```text cu: tensor([ 0, 4096, 8192], dtype=torch.int32) cu: tensor([ 0, 4096, 8192], dtype=torch.int32) seq_len = tensor([4096, 4096], dtype=torch.int32) seq_len = tensor([4096, 4096], dtype=torch.int32) ``` ## Accuracy Tests ## Speed Tests and Profiling After the fix we can run multiple image per request without VIT graph. ## Checklist - [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit). - [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). - [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). - [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). - [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance). ## Review and Merge Process 1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process). 2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers. 3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so. - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci` 4.
